source_row.rationale: Malignant hyperthermia can develop rapidly and unpredictably during anesthesia in susceptible individuals, so having a readily accessible MH cart with dantrolene and other supplies supports timely, life-saving treatment when this emergency occurs.
source_row.stem: An operating room maintains a readily accessible malignant hyperthermia (MH) cart, stocked with dantrolene and other emergency supplies. This preparedness is important because:
